entities.name: Alara
entities.description: The plane whose five shards have merged.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The planeswalker whose violent plans reached their cataclysmic zenith with the merging of Alara's shards.

entities.name: Elspeth
entities.description: The planeswalker who is the subject of the webcomic Honor Bound on Bant.

entities.name: Bant
entities.description: A shard of Alara where Elspeth sees the effects of the Conflux.

entities.name: Grixis
entities.description: A shard of Alara from which evil leaks into Bant.

entities.name: Conflux
entities.description: The event in which the shards of Alara converged.

events.summary: Nicol Bolas's plans reach their zenith as the five shards of Alara merge.
events.quote: The violent plans orchestrated by Nicol Bolas have reached their cataclysmic zenith, as the five shards of Alara are now merged

relations.note: Evil from Grixis leaks into Bant as the Conflux takes effect.
relations.quote: how the effects of the Conflux can be seen as the evil from Grixis leaks in
